mainEntity.name: Who is a good candidate for a tummy tuck?

acceptedAnswer.text: People with loose abdominal skin and weakened muscles after weight loss or pregnancy, who are in good health and at a stable weight.

mainEntity.name: Is a tummy tuck a weight-loss procedure?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It removes excess skin and some fat to reshape the abdomen, but it isn't a substitute for weight loss.

mainEntity.name: How long is recovery after abdominoplasty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Recovery varies from person to person. Most patients return to light activity within a few weeks, following their surgeon's guidance.
